set.body: Outcome: make scientific-plan admission and execution artifacts genuinely unforgeable outside their companions. Acceptance: BoundScientificPlan can arise only through validated Compile.prepare/binding; plan/result/receipt factories are companion-owned or publicly validating data; package-name spoofing cannot bypass admission; add compile-negative downstream attack; JVM/JS facade and receipt courts pass.
set.title: P7.2a: seal plan admission and receipt construction
